objective: Show large golden verified lifetime Points, Circle/All-time Rank, active cluster membership, public note, avatar, and background on both normal and locked BUKLOD member profiles without disclosing private activity or contacts.
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: main source 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f inspected Nov 22 2026; source-only, no served OTA fingerprint asserted.
chosenApproach: Reuse existing profile RPC to return a strictly whitelisted public identity bundle regardless of lock, while preserving private-field flags/omissions on locked profiles. Reuse golden lifetime hero and guard the scores RPC with auth, active-member and Official exclusions. No new native module.
selectionRationale: Current Profile knows lifetime points but not prominently; View Profile explicitly hides exact points. Reusing authoritative balance while enforcing server privacy avoids monthly, redeemable and fake zero values.
preserveBehaviors: Profile lock still hides username, join details, shared-scope history and private activities or posts; only the owner-approved public identity and metrics remain visible.
Profile photo, background, note, active cluster membership, Circle Rank, all-time rank, and earned Lifetime BP are readable even when locked.
All reward accounting, redeemed/available points, ledger, QMP, posts, ads, admin official isolation and navigation remain unchanged.
acceptanceChecks: New guarded SQL RPC returns authoritative exact lifetime_points only for authorized active visible members.
SQL post-migration rollback-only test checks auth, locked profile, Official exclusion, absent accounts, and grants.
Node contract confirms gold hero, no fabricated zero, focus refresh, data sources, navigation and privacy.
TypeScript, low-cost regression and engineering scope-lock CI required; no merge or OTA until passing.
No production Supabase migration or production/staging OTA executed by this code-only PR.
Locked-profile SQL rollback test verifies authorized public BP and field-by-field public-vs-private response boundaries.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Render a golden lifetime BP badge on Profile and Member screens while retaining existing feed, account and character functionality.
preservedBehaviors: Rank, activity, rewards, redemption and existing profile navigation are not changed.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Profile and member route display additional read-only server verified BP with secure user-scoped view permission.
preservedBehaviors: Member profile locking, profile navigation, self-account isolation, messages and official identity persist.

lockedFeatureChanges.reason: Add an authenticated privacy-checked lifetime BP read RPC and restrict legacy direct read helper grants to prevent locked-profile disclosure.
preservedBehaviors: Balance tables, existing ledger history, reward triggers, RLS, official exclusions, and internal definer function calls remain untouched.

alternativeApproaches: Use raw client SELECT for public lifetime balances (rejected due to RLS/privacy and broader data exposure).
Use rank or leaderboard points as a lifetime substitute (rejected due to incorrect data semantics).
Call existing public direct lifetime helpers (rejected because they lack authentication/profile-lock enforcement).
Disable all locks to show profile content (rejected: would leak sensitive information).
releaseTarget: future explicitly verified consolidated OTA after migration and runtime QA
